# qh

> Quick Http web-service construction


## Pages in this subsection

- [qh](qh.html.md): Quick HTTP: expose Python functions as a FastAPI web service with one call.
- [qh.app](qh.app.html.md): Build a FastAPI application from plain Python functions.
- [qh.async_endpoints](qh.async_endpoints.html.md): Helper functions to create task management endpoints.
- [qh.async_tasks](qh.async_tasks.html.md): Async task processing for qh.
- [qh.au_integration](qh.au_integration.html.md): Integration layer between qh and au.
- [qh.base](qh.base.html.md): Config-free dispatch of Python callables as FastAPI routes, plus a store dispatcher.
- [qh.client](qh.client.html.md): Python client generation from OpenAPI specs.
- [qh.config](qh.config.html.md): Configuration system for qh with layered defaults.
- [qh.conventions](qh.conventions.html.md): Convention-based routing for qh.
- [qh.core](qh.core.html.md): Minimal function-to-route dispatch built on &#96;i2.wrapper.Wrap&#96;.
- [qh.endpoint](qh.endpoint.html.md): Endpoint creation using i2.Wrap to transform functions into FastAPI routes.
- [qh.jsclient](qh.jsclient.html.md): JavaScript and TypeScript client generation from OpenAPI specs.
- [qh.openapi](qh.openapi.html.md): OpenAPI generation for qh — including JSON Schema derived from Python type hints.
- [qh.rules](qh.rules.html.md): Transformation rule system for qh.
- [qh.stores_qh](qh.stores_qh.html.md): FastAPI service for operating on stores objects.
- [qh.testing](qh.testing.html.md): Run a qh (or any FastAPI) app for a test: in-process, or on a real port.
- [qh.types](qh.types.html.md): Type registry for qh - automatic serialization/deserialization for custom types.
